H_normalization.Decimal_arguments: canonical finite design-scope strings, no exponent/trailing fractional zeros, zero=0
H_normalization.encoding: UTF-8 JSON array of listed identity arguments, ensure_ascii=false,separators=(comma,colon)

common.contact_clock: selected native TF only; OPEN>=eligibility_at and matching native context at that OPEN; contact published at native CLOSE
common.context_rule: required completed context must be admissible at eligibility_at; otherwise WAIT_CONTEXT_FOR_POI_ELIGIBILITY prospectively
common.eligibility_rule: eligibility_at=FIRST admissible completed M15 inventory cutoff at/after max(all completed family prerequisites), including required completed context/current M4 gate; no backdating
common.execution_clock: every M15 OPEN/bar after emission, even inside running H1/H4 contact bar; no active-at-native-OPEN prerequisite
common.first_test_rule: first native bar OPEN>=eligibility_at whose OHLC intersects selected POI; contact is known at that bar CLOSE
common.monotonic_ownership: eligibility_at latched once per selected physical POI; consumed/reserved/retired permanent; no reset by later confirmation or context reacquisition
common.native_context_rule: first eligible contact also requires selected native-TF direction context already admissible at native OPEN; context first learned at native CLOSE cannot retro-classify that bar

nullable_inventory_fields.eligibility_at: null until first admissible inventory cutoff
nullable_inventory_fields.origin_conf_id: null for generated objects until first eligible latch; SFP/OB own zone origin bound when known
nullable_inventory_fields.origin_conf_known_at: null for generated objects until origin CONF latch; SFP/OB own completed confirmation timestamp when known
nullable_inventory_fields.proposal_selected_conf_id: null before first H1 proposal; separately record current latest inherited M4 CONF when proposal is evaluated

common.origin_vs_proposal: generated STB/BREAKER/RANGE origin_conf_id is the confirmation latched by first eligibility cutoff; proposal_selected_conf_id is separately the latest inherited M4 CONF at H1 proposal. Later CONF cannot rebase an already latched physical POI. SFP/OB retain own refined-zone origin_bos_id mapped to matching completed confirmation_id.
common.partial_native_interval: native bar OPEN<eligibility_at is ineligible even if M15 eligibility begins inside it; no partial-bar first-test or retroactive OPEN
common.pre_emission_consumption: eligible native contact known_at<=emission_decision_at => REJECT_SELECTED_POI_PRECONSUMED; completed contacts applied before H1 emission
common.preproposal_inventory: Register selected physical objects from completed family evidence. At every completed M15 cutoff, before and independently of viable H1 proposal, evaluate inherited current M4 confirmation gate and required completed candidate context. The FIRST cutoff satisfying those plus all family prerequisites latches origin_conf_id and eligibility_at for that physical ID. No trade signal emitted by this inventory.
same_bar_ordering: apply completed lifecycle evidence known_at<=each M15 OPEN and half-open deadline
execute active order on every M15 bar, independently of native contact bar OPEN
advance completed D1,H4,H1,M15 at equal cutoff; publish native contact at CLOSE
fill by exclusive owner on any M15 bar in eligible native interval owns contact; exited exposure remains owner
consume/retire unfilled pending before next M15 OPEN
at H1 decision reserve only after completed contacts; contact at equal emission cutoff rejects

BREAKER.eligibility_at: FIRST admissible completed M15 inventory cutoff >= max(breaker_formation_known_at, origin_conf_known_at); includes required completed context and current inherited M4 confirmation gate
BREAKER.origin_conf: same-direction causal M15 CONF returned by inherited M4 gate at FIRST eligible completed-prefix cutoff, latched before viable H1 emission; later proposal CONF separate
BREAKER.reaction_required_at: completed native opposite body-break creating breaker
BREAKER.required_event_exemption: breaker-creation break cannot consume object that is created by that event

OB.eligibility_at: FIRST admissible completed M15 inventory cutoff >= max(zone_born_at, origin_conf_known_at, reaction_required_at); includes required completed context and current inherited M4 confirmation gate
OB.identity: existing selected refined M15 OB/FVG id
OB.origin_conf: selected refined POI own origin BOS/CONF
OB.required_event_exemption: parent reaction is not selected refined-POI consumption

RANGE.eligibility_at: FIRST admissible completed M15 inventory cutoff >= max(reaction_required_at, origin_conf_known_at); includes required completed context and current inherited M4 confirmation gate
RANGE.origin_conf: same-direction causal M15 CONF returned by inherited M4 gate at FIRST eligible completed-prefix cutoff, latched before viable H1 emission; later proposal CONF separate
RANGE.required_event_exemption: mandatory boundary reaction is explicitly exempt from selected-POI consumption

SFP.eligibility_at: FIRST admissible completed M15 inventory cutoff >= max(zone_born_at, origin_conf_known_at, reaction_required_at); includes required completed context and current inherited M4 confirmation gate
SFP.identity: existing selected refined M15 OB/FVG id
SFP.origin_conf: selected refined POI own origin BOS/CONF

STB.eligibility_at: FIRST admissible completed M15 inventory cutoff >= max(formation_known_at, origin_conf_known_at); includes required completed context and current inherited M4 confirmation gate
STB.origin_conf: same-direction causal M15 CONF returned by inherited M4 gate at FIRST eligible completed-prefix cutoff, latched before viable H1 emission; later proposal CONF separate
STB.parent_structural_invalidation: inherited full manipulation structural-anchor rule only
STB.required_event_exemption: manipulation/formation bar cannot consume generated STB body
